title: Project maintenance cleanup
changes: Removed completed migration tooling, temporary browser profiles, intermediate snapshots and download caches.
Archived unused legacy layouts, code-review reference pages and the replaced Inter font while retaining application workflows, compatibility routes, uploads and installation recovery files.

title: Clean application URLs
changes: Module navigation now uses extensionless CodeIgniter URLs.
Existing .php page bookmarks redirect to the clean location and preserve filters and query parameters.
Legacy API and form submissions remain supported with the same permissions and CSRF protection.

title: CodeIgniter foundation and readable views
changes: Moved module pages and endpoints into CodeIgniter 4 controllers and views while preserving existing links, permissions and workflows.
Added local HTMX record-search fragments, Alpine shared controls and compiled Tailwind styling. Light, Dark and System modes remain available.
Formatted first-party view templates with aligned HTML tags and repeatable formatting checks. Installed libraries, plugins and generated assets are excluded from source reviews.

title: Leave ranges, unified approvals and calendar birthdays
changes: Leave applications now accept Date From and Date To. Weekends and organization holidays are excluded, and one approval covers the whole working-day range.
Approvals is a separate module with Daily Logs and Leave tabs. Each keeps its own permissions and review rules; the leave calendar contains application controls.
User creation and editing now include an optional Birthday field. Birthdays appear annually on the department calendar without exposing birth years or ages.
Department visibility, section-only leave approval, Section Head self-approval, existing leave history and report totals are preserved.

title: Department leave calendar and section approvals
changes: Leave and undertime applications now have their own Leaves module with a department calendar, personal requests and a section approval queue.
Personnel can see submitted and approved leave across their department. Application remarks are limited to the applicant and authorized section approvers.
Grant Leaves Review to a chosen role in Roles & Permissions. Approvers are restricted to their own section, and Section Heads may approve their own leave.
Weekly daily-log approval now covers work activities only. Existing leave records, team hour totals and report exports are preserved.

title: Edit submitted daily logs
changes: Personnel with Daily Logs Edit permission can now update their own submitted work and leave entries while awaiting weekly approval.
Submitted entries use Save Changes and remain submitted. Reviewers must refresh a changed weekly snapshot before approving; reviewed entries remain locked.
Existing ownership, record version, working-day and daily-hour validation still apply. Deleting entries remains limited to Draft and Returned logs.

title: QMS standards and maintenance checks
changes: Applied QMS source headers, naming, vertical braces, four-space layout and separate statements throughout first-party modules and shared code.
Moved static inline module styles into an external stylesheet and separated metadata connection setup from catalog processing.
Installation secrets now use authenticated encrypted local configuration. Existing connection values and the vault key are preserved.
Added repeatable QMS audits, module validation reports and matching named migration logs. Existing database and API names remain compatible.
Corrected QMS diagnostics for nested JavaScript templates, boolean expressions, markup and logical switch indentation.

title: Larger project reviews and activity guidance
changes: Code Review now scans up to 3,000 supported source files from a computer or server folder, with a 48 MB total source allowance and the existing 256 KB per-file limit.
Large project reviews continue to save their history and export to Excel or ODS. Existing folder exclusions and displayed finding limits apply.
All 20 Activity Types now show their full reference descriptions directly below the selector when adding or editing daily logs.

title: Your next actions, reminders and record search
changes: The dashboard now prioritizes missing hours, returned logs, pending employee-week approvals, section completion and renewals.
Daily-log and weekly-approval digests run on working days with configurable timing, lookback and approval delay. New log-reminder email is off by default.
Search workspace finds personnel, servers, dictionary tables and fields, ERDs, saved reviews, contacts, links and your own daily logs. Results follow permissions and section scope.
Dashboard actions and search results open the relevant record or filtered workflow. Applications and Requirements remain hidden.

title: Consistent typography, icons and feedback
changes: Poppins typography is applied across the interface using locally hosted font files.
Lucide is the shared icon library for navigation, controls, empty states and feedback.
SweetAlert2 now provides confirmations and notifications across all modules, with Light and Dark appearance.
Confirmation actions wait for your decision and remain accessible above open editors.

title: Poppins typography
changes: Poppins is now the interface font across DevAtlas, including navigation, forms, dashboards and documentation.
Font files are hosted locally and work in Light, Dark and System appearance.

title: Introducing DevAtlas
changes: The system is now DevAtlas, with a modern enterprise IT management identity.
A unified electric-blue, navy and cyan design covers the dashboard, modules, sign-in and documentation.
Choose Light, Dark or System appearance. System follows your device and responds when its color preference changes.
Inter typography and Lucide icons are bundled locally. Existing data, approvals, exports, permissions and workflows are retained.
The login page now presents a DevAtlas workspace overview, with Call Directory and Quick Links in the header. Email sign-in and recovery no longer display protected-email fallback messages.
Appearance controls are in the account menu and standalone-page footers, keeping headers focused.
Applications and Requirements are temporarily hidden from navigation, search and the permission matrix. Existing data and grants are retained.

title: Head approvals, standalone help and update history
changes: Holidays is now in the Parameter sidebar group and permission-matrix group.
Section Head and Department Head roles can approve their own submitted employee weeks. Reviewing other employees still requires a section reviewer assignment.
Documents Wiki now opens as a separate page from the top-bar Help menu and no longer appears in the sidebar.
What's New opens in a modal with newest-first history. It appears for each new release and remembers dismissal for each user.

title: Module guides and the organization holiday calendar
changes: Added searchable guides for every module and a roadmap separating delivered features from planned work.
Moved Holidays into a separate module with organization-wide dates, a year filter and administrator editing.
Grouped Users, Organization, Roles & Permissions and Parameters under Parameter in the sidebar and permission matrix.
